scope: 45 finite mechanism families from the existing roadmap, not all possible theories
empty_space_explanation: set aside per user; historical records preserved

mechanisms.name: Effective dimension
mechanisms.proposal: derive whether disks, spheres, filaments, or a continuous dimensionality variable changes the gravitational response; test galaxies versus clusters.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Shape and anisotropy
mechanisms.proposal: use flattening, triaxiality, orientation, and quadrupole structure to predict `F(Z)` without an object label.
mechanisms.current_test: Partial new shape/morphology tests; exact 3D anisotropy unavailable

mechanisms.name: Surface versus volume density
mechanisms.proposal: test whether a dimensionless combination of surface and volume density explains the cross-scale coefficient.
mechanisms.current_test: New surface proxies tested; true volume density unmeasured

mechanisms.name: Baryonic compactness
mechanisms.proposal: derive and test dependence on mass-to-size or potential-depth ratios.
mechanisms.current_test: New compactness/potential proxies tested

mechanisms.name: Pressure support
mechanisms.proposal: include rotational, thermal, turbulent, and velocity-dispersion support in one observable dynamics relation.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Thermodynamic state
mechanisms.proposal: test temperature, entropy, cooling time, and pressure gradients as causal variables rather than identifiers.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Baryonic composition
mechanisms.proposal: test universal dependence on gas, stars, plasma, molecular matter, and their spatial mixtures.
mechanisms.current_test: New composition lead, substantially reduced by stellar-mass calibration

mechanisms.name: Field gradients and curvature
mechanisms.proposal: generate laws from acceleration gradients, baryonic-potential curvature, tidal invariants, and higher derivatives.
mechanisms.current_test: New radial gradient/curvature tests

mechanisms.name: Interior/exterior balance
mechanisms.proposal: test whether the distribution of baryons inside and outside a radius predicts a redirected or nonlocal response.
mechanisms.current_test: New inner/outer radial light/force tests; no full 3D shells

mechanisms.name: Baryonic boundaries
mechanisms.proposal: derive surface, edge, shell, interface, and finite-domain terms that can focus gravity back toward baryonic regions.
mechanisms.current_test: Partial profile-boundary tests; coverage diagnostic

mechanisms.name: External baryonic field
mechanisms.proposal: test neighboring baryons, large-scale structure, and tidal environment under strict target blindness.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Dynamical age
mechanisms.proposal: test formation-time and settling-time proxies for a universal history-dependent response.
mechanisms.current_test: New spectral-population proxy prediction and sample transport; orbit age unmeasured

mechanisms.name: Relaxation and mergers
mechanisms.proposal: test equilibrium, disturbance, and merger-state observables as predictors of deviations.
mechanisms.current_test: New imaging disturbance tests give model-dependent results

mechanisms.name: Resonance and coherence
mechanisms.proposal: derive whether long-lived orbital, field, or collective modes synchronize outer and inner speeds over cosmic time.
mechanisms.current_test: No direct resonance phase measurement; radial profile proxies only

mechanisms.name: Timescale ratios
mechanisms.proposal: generate dimensionless laws from orbital, crossing, cooling, free-fall, relaxation, and cosmic timescale ratios.
mechanisms.current_test: Source-only period/crossing proxies tested and algebraically identified

mechanisms.name: QED-like gravity
mechanisms.proposal: construct a quantum-field-style grammar with carriers, vertices, propagators, loop corrections, running couplings, and polarization while enforcing a classical limit.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Running gravitational strength
mechanisms.proposal: allow the effective coupling to grow or shrink with distance, momentum, curvature, density, or environment; test one universal running law.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Gravitational antiscreening
mechanisms.proposal: test whether vacuum or field self-interactions strengthen gravity at large scales while satisfying local constraints.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Massive gravitational particles
mechanisms.proposal: explore Yukawa-like carriers and other finite-range modes with universal masses and couplings.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Massive phases or periods
mechanisms.proposal: allow gravity to enter long-duration or scale-dependent phases in which a massive mode dominates, then derive the transitions rather than fitting them per object.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Mixed massive and massless modes
mechanisms.proposal: test universal interference or crossover between long-range and finite-range gravitational degrees of freedom.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Multiple gravitational polarizations
mechanisms.proposal: explore scalar, vector, and tensor responses and require the same fields to predict motion and lensing.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Bimetric or multi-metric gravity
mechanisms.proposal: generate interacting-metric candidates with explicit matter coupling, stability, and observable limits.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Different behavior of time
mechanisms.proposal: allow clock rate, lapse, temporal dimension, or time response to depend on environment and derive both dynamics and light propagation.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Time-varying gravity
mechanisms.proposal: test universal cosmic or local evolution of gravitational strength against present-day and historical constraints.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Retarded gravity
mechanisms.proposal: explore finite-propagation and baryonic-history kernels instead of instantaneous response.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Gravitational memory
mechanisms.proposal: test whether the field retains a causal, fading record of earlier baryonic configurations.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Periodic gravity
mechanisms.proposal: generate spatial, temporal, logarithmic-scale, or phase oscillations and test their common wavelength and phase rules.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Nonlinear self-interaction
mechanisms.proposal: derive scale changes from the gravitational field's own energy or nonlinear equations rather than object-specific parameters.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Screening mechanisms
mechanisms.proposal: explore chameleon, symmetron, Vainshtein-like, and newly generated screening structures with galaxy-to-local-gravity continuity.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Vacuum polarization or permittivity
mechanisms.proposal: model the vacuum as a gravitational medium whose response is derived from local invariants and universal constants.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Boundary focusing
mechanisms.proposal: formalize the idea that gravity bends or redirects into baryon-rich regions and test the resulting vector/tensor field, not merely radial curve fits.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Phase-transition gravity
mechanisms.proposal: derive universal critical variables and crossovers between weak-field regimes.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Condensate or superfluid behavior
mechanisms.proposal: explore coherent gravitational-field phases while distinguishing new gravity from relabeled unseen matter.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Modified inertia
mechanisms.proposal: generate action-level candidates in which response to force changes, then test noncircular motion and conservation laws.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Extra dimensions
mechanisms.proposal: search compactified, warped, emergent, or scale-dependent dimensional models with observable four-dimensional limits.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Alternative geometry
mechanisms.proposal: explore torsion, nonmetricity, Finsler-like, affine, or other geometric invariants beyond metric curvature.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Emergent gravity
mechanisms.proposal: derive the effective law from thermodynamic, entropic, information-theoretic, or collective microscopic variables.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Holographic or boundary gravity
mechanisms.proposal: test whether bulk behavior follows from baryonic or spacetime boundary data under a universal mapping.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Discrete or network gravity
mechanisms.proposal: generate graph, lattice, causal-set, and connectivity-based laws whose continuum limits are explicit.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Stochastic gravity
mechanisms.proposal: test whether universal field fluctuations or noise-induced drift create reproducible scale-dependent means and variances.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Matter-geometry feedback
mechanisms.proposal: derive nonlinear feedback in which baryonic organization changes geometry and geometry changes baryonic motion.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Cosmological boundary coupling
mechanisms.proposal: test universal dependence on expansion, horizon, background curvature, or large-scale boundary conditions.
mechanisms.current_test: No new direct test in this round; requires a derived observable prediction and appropriate source data

mechanisms.name: Scale hierarchy
mechanisms.proposal: generate laws from ratios among baryonic size, gravitational transition length, carrier wavelength, curvature radius, and horizon scale.
mechanisms.current_test: Partial size and radial-scale ratios tested

mechanisms.name: Universal interaction variables
mechanisms.proposal: automatically synthesize dimensionless cross-terms among geometry, density, gradients, time, environment, and field invariants.
mechanisms.current_test: New limited nonlinear transforms and combined ridge
